*   Rank parameter: $k$ controls the rank of the modulation $A \times B$ [S1, unofficial].

The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly defines the FMM layer equation as $y = W ⊙ (A × B) · x_in + b$ and states that 'A and B are two modulation matrices... with dimensions n_out × k and k × n_in, respectively.' Since the dimensions of A ($n_{out} × k$) and B ($k × n_{in}$) dictate that the product $A × B$ has a rank at most $k$, and the text explicitly says $k$ controls this rank, the claim is fully supported by the evidence.
